g.text: Paste the Google Drive link (always required)
Type the details and paste the abstract
(or go back and choose the PDF from the computer)
pdfFileProblem: not a PDF or empty?
Keep the PDF (over 100 MB: kept with a warning)
Message under the Drive link field,
(retry after 1 s and 3 s if Drive is busy)
"This file is protected, so it can't be read from
Google Drive. Choose the PDF from this computer
instead." Also: not a PDF, offline, Drive busy

stops one page after the abstract ends
Unclear values are left EMPTY with a grey note
colleges, ambiguous programme such as BSA).

Scanned PDF or no abstract found?

Abstract + keywords printed in the PDF
(marked AUTO), never more than 8 in all
Check & save opens at the top of the page,
"Possible duplicate - this study may already be
then click Save." (next click is taken)

All fields valid? Title, 1+ author, college,
Show the reason, keep the form open
